storage_policy: Raw HTML/XML sources are not committed. URLs + SHA-256 + retrieved_at bind assertions to the retrieved bytes. Catastro records are re-fetchable live via the request URLs.

sources.title: Hansson & Hertzell property feed (Janela Digital transporter)
sources.finding: 36 properties. No 'Turis', no 'Benicolet', no titled 'Essence' project. 'essence' appears only as a marketing word in descriptions. All <location> lat/long = 0. No floorplans in schema (images only). CONCLUSION: Essence Moraira is NOT carried in this feed.

sources.title: Essence Moraira official project microsite (Wix)
sources.finding: PRIMARY SOURCE. 4 villas (PARCELA 01-04), all 4-bed. Villa specs transcribed into project-v0.1.json. No map pin / lat-long embedded server-side.

sources.title: Grupo Turis Promociones — projects page
sources.finding: Links Essence Moraira to essencemoraira.com; 'promotion of four exclusive homes'.
